title: Mixed Event — What lies behind. What lies ahead. — Episode1 Everyone at Arm's Length

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.
meta.Event Outline: With the song that made Mafuyu smile complete, positive responses from fans come flooding in. Meanwhile, Mizuki feels like the only one unable to get closer to the other members. One day, the group bumps into An, who has seen a side to Mizuki that the others haven't...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<How is it, K?
I tried out all of your suggestions and tried to fix up the ending...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The video syncs up with the chorus much better now. Let's go with this.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I'm just glad we managed to figure everything out...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And thanks for helping me edit everything towards the end there, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now I feel sleep deprived now because of that... Make sure to get some real sleep in tonight, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I will.
I'll start by sleeping in until noon!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, this means our song and music video are both done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We finally get to upload it. The song that made Mafuyu smile...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She and Kanade put so much effort into this song too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I hope this gets a ton of views!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. I can't wait to see what people say about it, but I should probably hit the hay now... *Yawn*...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Great work, everyone.
This took a lot out of us, so we should all get some well-deserved rest.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Night.
Oh, I think I'll take a bath first...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I still feel really drowsy. I guess I did stay up pretty late last night.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's 10:00...?
I don't have school or work today, so I can go back to... Wait!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Our new song!
What are people saying about it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?! It has this many views already?! In less than half a day...?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I didn't know they could make music like this.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I've had a lot on my mind lately, but I feel way better after hearing this song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The others really put everything they had into this song, so I couldn't be happier.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Especially Kanade... She really is an incredible person...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It all started with Mafuyu saying, “This isn't good enough.” And now, she's found a way to reach not just Mafuyu, but all these other people...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's not just Kanade either. Mafuyu and Ena are also really amazing people.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They're taking a hard look at themselves and facing their problems despite how uncomfortable that might be.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm still stuck in the same place...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? A message? At this time?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You awake? Did you see the view count?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Ena...
She's awake already?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I saw! Isn't it awesome?! It's like double what we usually get!> And send...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Everyone's saying that the video goes really well with the music, so this one might end up becoming our best one yet, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
I hope K and Yuki get to enjoy this too!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This also means we should pick a date to do an after party. When are you gonna be free, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <My work schedule hasn't been decided yet, but I should know sometime this week. I'll let you know when I find out.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay.
I'll ask K and Yuki in the meantime.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <These things aren't as fun when you're not there.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But Ena really is a good person...
I mean, she's willing to put up with me like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know that I haven't made any progress up until now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I hope that I'll become closer with them, someday...)
